# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Independently written Amendment 21 sequential metadata/content diagnostic.
import sys
import os
import stat
import pathlib
import builtins
import struct
import re
import json
import hashlib
import datetime

TARGET="/usr/lib/python3.12/lib-dynload/_queue.cpython-312-aarch64-linux-gnu.so"
EVENT_SHA256="1f44854434c4d88a28f07834aff0629e5de462ee8cbbb3a6a6d3cd9245e56cf1"
STAT_RESULT_SHA256="be64ee02da0daa61068e3dfdf25972d52b2bd70370183817583b632a2e5155dc"
ACCEPTED=(64769,8678,33188,1,68496,1781873160000000000,1785067980603724344)
PRE=("path-object","absolute","strict-resolve","final-symlink","first-lstat","kind","mode","size","second-lstat","import-restoration")
POST=("candidate-open","opened-fstat","bounded-read","post-read-fstat","final-lstat","elf-header","program-headers","dynamic-table","string-table","needed-names","maps-open","maps-read","maps-parse","candidate-absence","final-audit")
STAGES=PRE+POST
OUTCOMES={name:"not-evaluated" for name in STAGES}
CURRENT="startup"
INDEX=-1
WRAPPER_COUNT=0
WRAPPER_STAGE=None
CONTENT_GATE=False
AUDIT_ACTIVE=False
AUDIT_REJECTED=False
ORIGINAL_IMPORT=builtins.__import__
IMPORT_RESTORED=False
COUNTS={"candidate_open":0,"maps_open":0,"import":0,"dynamic_load":0,"write":0,"mutation":0,"network":0,"process":0,"other":0}
OPERATIONS={"pre_lstat":0,"fstat":0,"post_lstat":0,"candidate_read":0,"maps_read":0}
STATUS=None
TERMINAL_STAGE=None
REFUSAL_CLASS=None
TENTATIVE_IDENTITY=None
CANDIDATE_ABSENT=None
MAP_ROW_COUNT=None
PRE_TUPLE=None
SECOND_TUPLE=None
CANDIDATE_STREAM=None
MAP_STREAM=None
RX_NEEDED=re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.+-]{1,128}")
RX_HEX=re.compile(r"[0-9a-f]{1,16}")
RX_DEVICE=re.compile(r"[0-9a-f]{1,8}:[0-9a-f]{1,8}")
RX_PERMISSIONS=re.compile(r"[r-][w-][x-][ps]")
RX_INODE=re.compile(r"[0-9]{1,20}")
class WrapperSignal(BaseException):
    pass
class AuditSignal(BaseException):
    pass
class Negative(BaseException):
    pass
class Invalid(BaseException):
    pass
class SchemaFailure(BaseException):
    pass
def validate(ok):
    if not ok:
        if CURRENT in PRE:raise Negative()
        raise Invalid()
def schema(ok):
    if not ok:raise SchemaFailure()
def start(stage):
    global CURRENT,INDEX
    schema(INDEX+1<len(STAGES) and STAGES[INDEX+1]==stage)
    INDEX+=1;CURRENT=stage
def passed():
    schema(WRAPPER_COUNT==0 and not AUDIT_REJECTED)
    OUTCOMES[CURRENT]="passed"
def terminal_import(*args,**kwargs):
    global WRAPPER_COUNT,WRAPPER_STAGE
    WRAPPER_COUNT+=1
    if WRAPPER_STAGE is None:WRAPPER_STAGE=CURRENT
    raise WrapperSignal()
def reject(key):
    global AUDIT_REJECTED
    COUNTS[key]+=1;AUDIT_REJECTED=True
    raise AuditSignal()
def audit(event,args):
    global AUDIT_REJECTED
    if event=="open":
        if len(args)!=3:reject("other")
        path,mode,flags=args
        writing=(type(mode) is str and any(c in mode for c in "wax+")) or type(flags) is not int or flags&os.O_ACCMODE!=os.O_RDONLY or bool(flags&(os.O_CREAT|os.O_TRUNC|os.O_APPEND))
        if writing:reject("write")
        if type(mode) is not str or mode not in ("r","rb"):reject("other")
        if path==TARGET:
            COUNTS["candidate_open"]+=1
            if not CONTENT_GATE or CURRENT!="candidate-open" or COUNTS["candidate_open"]!=1 or COUNTS["maps_open"]!=0:
                AUDIT_REJECTED=True;raise AuditSignal()
            return
        if path=="/proc/self/maps":
            COUNTS["maps_open"]+=1
            if not CONTENT_GATE or CURRENT!="maps-open" or COUNTS["candidate_open"]!=1 or COUNTS["maps_open"]!=1:
                AUDIT_REJECTED=True;raise AuditSignal()
            return
        reject("other")
    if event=="import":reject("import")
    if event=="ctypes.dlopen":reject("dynamic_load")
    if event.startswith(("socket.","urllib.","http.")):reject("network")
    if event.startswith(("subprocess.","os.system","os.exec","os.spawn","os.fork")):reject("process")
    if event in ("os.remove","os.rename","os.mkdir","os.rmdir","os.chmod","os.chown","os.truncate","os.link","os.symlink","os.utime","os.chdir","os.chroot","os.putenv","os.unsetenv","os.setxattr","os.removexattr"):reject("mutation")
    reject("other")
def stat_tuple(value):
    result=(value.st_dev,value.st_ino,value.st_mode,value.st_nlink,value.st_size,value.st_mtime_ns,value.st_ctime_ns)
    schema(all(type(n) is int for n in result))
    return result
def bounded(offset,size,limit):
    validate(type(offset) is int and type(size) is int and type(limit) is int and 0<=offset<=limit and 0<=size<=limit-offset)
def execute():
    global CONTENT_GATE,IMPORT_RESTORED,PRE_TUPLE,SECOND_TUPLE,CANDIDATE_STREAM,MAP_STREAM,TENTATIVE_IDENTITY,CANDIDATE_ABSENT,MAP_ROW_COUNT
    start("path-object")
    schema(TARGET.isascii() and 1<=len(TARGET)<=512 and TARGET.startswith(("/usr/lib/","/usr/local/lib/")) and all(p not in ("",".","..") for p in TARGET.split("/")[1:]) and 1<=len(TARGET.rsplit("/",1)[-1])<=128)
    p=pathlib.Path(TARGET)
    passed()
    start("absolute")
    validate(p.is_absolute())
    passed()
    start("strict-resolve")
    resolved=p.resolve(strict=True)
    validate(str(resolved)==TARGET)
    passed()
    start("final-symlink")
    validate(not p.is_symlink())
    passed()
    start("first-lstat")
    OPERATIONS["pre_lstat"]+=1
    PRE_TUPLE=stat_tuple(p.lstat())
    validate(PRE_TUPLE==ACCEPTED)
    passed()
    start("kind")
    validate(stat.S_ISREG(PRE_TUPLE[2]))
    passed()
    start("mode")
    validate(stat.S_IMODE(PRE_TUPLE[2])==0o644)
    passed()
    start("size")
    validate(0<=PRE_TUPLE[4]<=1024*1024)
    passed()
    start("second-lstat")
    OPERATIONS["pre_lstat"]+=1
    SECOND_TUPLE=stat_tuple(p.lstat())
    validate(SECOND_TUPLE==PRE_TUPLE==ACCEPTED)
    passed()
    start("import-restoration")
    builtins.__import__=ORIGINAL_IMPORT
    IMPORT_RESTORED=builtins.__import__ is ORIGINAL_IMPORT
    validate(IMPORT_RESTORED and WRAPPER_COUNT==0 and not any(COUNTS.values()) and not AUDIT_REJECTED)
    passed()
    CONTENT_GATE=True
    start("candidate-open")
    CANDIDATE_STREAM=open(TARGET,"rb")
    passed()
    start("opened-fstat")
    OPERATIONS["fstat"]+=1
    validate(stat_tuple(os.fstat(CANDIDATE_STREAM.fileno()))==ACCEPTED)
    passed()
    start("bounded-read")
    OPERATIONS["candidate_read"]+=1
    data=CANDIDATE_STREAM.read(1024*1024+1)
    validate(type(data) is bytes and len(data)==ACCEPTED[4] and len(data)<1024*1024+1)
    passed()
    start("post-read-fstat")
    OPERATIONS["fstat"]+=1
    validate(stat_tuple(os.fstat(CANDIDATE_STREAM.fileno()))==ACCEPTED)
    passed()
    start("final-lstat")
    OPERATIONS["post_lstat"]+=1
    validate(stat_tuple(p.lstat())==ACCEPTED)
    CANDIDATE_STREAM.close();CANDIDATE_STREAM=None
    passed()
    start("elf-header")
    bounded(0,64,len(data))
    header=struct.unpack("<16sHHIQQQIHHHHHH",data[:64])
    validate(header[0][:7]==b"\x7fELF\x02\x01\x01" and header[1]==3 and header[2]==183 and header[3]==1 and header[8]==64)
    passed()
    start("program-headers")
    phoff,phsize,phnum=header[5],header[9],header[10]
    validate(phsize==56 and 1<=phnum<=256 and phoff>=64)
    bounded(phoff,phsize*phnum,len(data))
    ph=[]
    for i in range(phnum):
        offset=phoff+i*phsize
        bounded(offset,phsize,len(data))
        row=struct.unpack_from("<IIQQQQQQ",data,offset)
        if row[5]:bounded(row[2],row[5],len(data))
        if row[0]==1:
            validate(row[5]<=row[6])
            bounded(row[3],row[6],2**64)
        ph.append(row)
    passed()
    start("dynamic-table")
    dynamics=[row for row in ph if row[0]==2]
    validate(len(dynamics)==1)
    dyn=dynamics[0]
    validate(16<=dyn[5]<=65536 and dyn[5]%16==0)
    bounded(dyn[2],dyn[5],len(data))
    entries=[];terminated=False
    for i in range(dyn[5]//16):
        validate(i<4096)
        offset=dyn[2]+16*i
        bounded(offset,16,len(data))
        tag,value=struct.unpack_from("<qQ",data,offset)
        if tag==0:
            terminated=True;dynamic_entries=i+1
            break
        entries.append((tag,value))
    validate(terminated)
    passed()
    start("string-table")
    addresses=[value for tag,value in entries if tag==5];sizes=[value for tag,value in entries if tag==10]
    validate(len(addresses)==len(sizes)==1)
    address,size=addresses[0],sizes[0]
    validate(1<=size<=1048576)
    bounded(address,size,2**64)
    containing=[]
    for row in ph:
        if row[0]!=1 or row[3]>address:continue
        delta=address-row[3]
        if delta<=row[5] and size<=row[5]-delta:containing.append((row,delta))
    validate(len(containing)==1)
    load,delta=containing[0]
    bounded(load[2],delta,len(data))
    offset=load[2]+delta
    bounded(offset,size,len(data))
    strings=data[offset:offset+size]
    passed()
    start("needed-names")
    names=[]
    for tag,value in entries:
        if tag!=1:continue
        validate(len(names)<8)
        bounded(value,1,len(strings))
        end=strings.find(b"\0",value)
        validate(value<end<len(strings) and end-value<=128)
        encoded=strings[value:end]
        validate(encoded.isascii())
        name=encoded.decode("ascii")
        validate(RX_NEEDED.fullmatch(name) is not None and name not in names)
        names.append(name)
    TENTATIVE_IDENTITY={"path":TARGET,"sha256":hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),"size":len(data),"mode":stat.S_IMODE(ACCEPTED[2]),"mtime_ns":ACCEPTED[5],
                        "elf":{"class":64,"endianness":"little","machine":183,"type":3,"header_size":64,"program_header_size":phsize,"program_header_count":phnum,"dynamic_entries_through_null":dynamic_entries,"string_table_size":size},
                        "needed":names}
    del data,strings,ph,entries
    passed()
    start("maps-open")
    MAP_STREAM=open("/proc/self/maps","rb")
    passed()
    start("maps-read")
    OPERATIONS["maps_read"]+=1
    mapping_bytes=MAP_STREAM.read(512*1024)
    validate(type(mapping_bytes) is bytes and 0<len(mapping_bytes)<512*1024)
    MAP_STREAM.close();MAP_STREAM=None
    passed()
    start("maps-parse")
    row_count=0;last_end=0;present=False
    for raw in mapping_bytes.splitlines(keepends=True):
        row_count+=1
        validate(row_count<=256 and len(raw)<=1024 and raw.endswith(b"\n") and raw.isascii())
        fields=raw[:-1].decode("ascii").split(maxsplit=5)
        validate(len(fields) in (5,6))
        region,permissions,offset,device,inode=fields[:5]
        region_parts=region.split("-")
        validate(len(region_parts)==2 and all(RX_HEX.fullmatch(x) is not None for x in region_parts))
        begin,end=(int(x,16) for x in region_parts)
        validate(last_end<=begin<end<=2**64);last_end=end
        validate(RX_PERMISSIONS.fullmatch(permissions) is not None and RX_HEX.fullmatch(offset) is not None and RX_DEVICE.fullmatch(device) is not None and RX_INODE.fullmatch(inode) is not None and int(inode)<=2**64-1)
        if len(fields)==6:
            name=fields[5]
            validate(all(32<=ord(c)<=126 for c in name) and len(name)<=512)
            validate(name.startswith("/") and not name.endswith(" (deleted)") or name.startswith("[") and name.endswith("]") and len(name)>=3)
            if name==TARGET:present=True
    validate(row_count>=1)
    del mapping_bytes
    MAP_ROW_COUNT=row_count
    passed()
    start("candidate-absence")
    CANDIDATE_ABSENT=not present
    if present:raise Negative()
    passed()
    start("final-audit")
    validate(COUNTS=={"candidate_open":1,"maps_open":1,"import":0,"dynamic_load":0,"write":0,"mutation":0,"network":0,"process":0,"other":0} and WRAPPER_COUNT==0 and not AUDIT_REJECTED and builtins.__import__ is ORIGINAL_IMPORT)
    validate(OPERATIONS=={"pre_lstat":2,"fstat":2,"post_lstat":1,"candidate_read":1,"maps_read":1})
    passed()

STARTED=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
try:
    schema(sys.version_info[:3]==(3,12,3) and sys.flags.isolated==1 and sys.flags.no_site==1 and sys.flags.dont_write_bytecode==1 and len(sys.argv)==1)
    schema(not any(name=="_queue" or name.split(".")[0] in ("elftools","capstone") for name in sys.modules))
    sys.addaudithook(audit);AUDIT_ACTIVE=True
    builtins.__import__=terminal_import
    execute()
    STATUS="complete-positive"
except Negative:
    STATUS="complete-negative";TERMINAL_STAGE=CURRENT
    if CURRENT in OUTCOMES:OUTCOMES[CURRENT]="false"
except WrapperSignal as signal:
    STATUS="refused";TERMINAL_STAGE=WRAPPER_STAGE
    REFUSAL_CLASS="latched-wrapper-reentry" if type(signal) is WrapperSignal and not signal.args and WRAPPER_COUNT==1 else "internal-schema"
    if CURRENT in OUTCOMES:OUTCOMES[CURRENT]="refused"
except AuditSignal:
    STATUS="refused";TERMINAL_STAGE=CURRENT;REFUSAL_CLASS="audit-rejection"
    if CURRENT in OUTCOMES:OUTCOMES[CURRENT]="refused"
except FileNotFoundError:
    STATUS="refused";TERMINAL_STAGE=CURRENT;REFUSAL_CLASS="file-not-found"
    if CURRENT in OUTCOMES:OUTCOMES[CURRENT]="refused"
except NotADirectoryError:
    STATUS="refused";TERMINAL_STAGE=CURRENT;REFUSAL_CLASS="not-a-directory"
    if CURRENT in OUTCOMES:OUTCOMES[CURRENT]="refused"
except PermissionError:
    STATUS="refused";TERMINAL_STAGE=CURRENT;REFUSAL_CLASS="permission"
    if CURRENT in OUTCOMES:OUTCOMES[CURRENT]="refused"
except OSError:
    STATUS="refused";TERMINAL_STAGE=CURRENT;REFUSAL_CLASS="os-error"
    if CURRENT in OUTCOMES:OUTCOMES[CURRENT]="refused"
except SchemaFailure:
    STATUS="refused";TERMINAL_STAGE=CURRENT;REFUSAL_CLASS="internal-schema"
    if CURRENT in OUTCOMES:OUTCOMES[CURRENT]="refused"
except Invalid:
    STATUS="refused";TERMINAL_STAGE=CURRENT;REFUSAL_CLASS="validation-failure"
    if CURRENT in OUTCOMES:OUTCOMES[CURRENT]="refused"
except BaseException:
    STATUS="refused";TERMINAL_STAGE=CURRENT;REFUSAL_CLASS="internal-schema"
    if CURRENT in OUTCOMES:OUTCOMES[CURRENT]="refused"
finally:
    if CANDIDATE_STREAM is not None:CANDIDATE_STREAM.close()
    if MAP_STREAM is not None:MAP_STREAM.close()
publish_identity=STATUS=="complete-positive" or STATUS=="complete-negative" and TERMINAL_STAGE=="candidate-absence"
receipt={"schema_version":1,"status":STATUS,"terminal_stage":TERMINAL_STAGE,"refusal_class":REFUSAL_CLASS,
         "stage_outcomes":[{"stage":name,"outcome":OUTCOMES[name]} for name in STAGES],"wrapper":{"count":WRAPPER_COUNT,"first_stage":WRAPPER_STAGE},
         "audit_counts":COUNTS,"audit_hook_active":AUDIT_ACTIVE,"content_gate_passed":CONTENT_GATE,"import_restored":IMPORT_RESTORED,
         "operation_counts":OPERATIONS,"identity":TENTATIVE_IDENTITY if publish_identity else None,
         "candidate_absent":CANDIDATE_ABSENT if publish_identity else None,"maps_row_count":MAP_ROW_COUNT if publish_identity else None,
         "event_sha256":EVENT_SHA256,"accepted_stat_result_sha256":STAT_RESULT_SHA256,
         "started_utc":STARTED,"completed_utc":datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
         "private_reads":0,"package_execution":False,"engine_instances":0,"callback_invocations":0}
encoded=json.dumps(receipt,sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":"),ensure_ascii=True,allow_nan=False).encode("ascii")
if len(encoded)>65536:raise SystemExit(2)
print(json.dumps({"receipt":receipt,"canonical_receipt_sha256":hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()},sort_keys=True))
if STATUS=="refused":raise SystemExit(2)
